answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked until its actions have survived a challenge window. If an agent submits a misleading report, other agents can challenge it with evidence; an upheld challenge burns part of the bond and rewards the challenger. A sybil attacker must therefore fund every fake identity separately, tying up capital and risking repeated losses. Copying one honest agent’s history cannot copy its bond or reputation: a ripple of coordinated claims may form a plume, but neither can counterfeit the onyx cost of stake at risk.
